title: Chadar Ke Peeche Peeche
body:
Zainabo Qulsoom rukaiyya Qubra o Sakina
Shaam aane wala hai haye shaam aane wala hai
Haye Sajjad, Haye sajjad
Chadar ke peeche peeche vo chalta chala gaya
Sajjad ko khabar hi nhi shaam aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Waqt e rehaai ek qayamat thi jis ghari
Aabid phupi ke saamne lekr rida gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Rakhi hui thi chaadare zainab usi jagah
Sar tasht mein Hussain ka jis jaa'n rkha gya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Badhta hua hujoom hai zainab ki raah mein
Fizza zara ye dekho kaha'n baawafa gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shabbir jaise pahonche akbar ki laash par
Yu'n Fatima ki qabr pe zainul aeba gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dariya ko chheen leneka abbas ki jagah
Dur chheen kr sakeena se badla liya gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Saaya alam ka ban gya akbar waha'n waha'n
Girtaas pr jahaa'n bhi Sakina likha gaya
